Bottom line: the Magic win 75 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee are 1-11 after eight straight losses and are closing in on the franchise's worst-ever start. First-year coach Taylor Jenkins has admitted "what we're doing right now is not working", and Kyle Kuzma has publicly demanded more urgency. Orlando just won two straight on the road for their first winning streak, with Franz Wagner scoring 71 points over those two games. They are still looking for their first home win under Sean Sweeney, and Paolo Banchero is still out. The Magic carry the better mood into this NBA Cup game, but their home drought is a mild counterweight.
